summary: The S. 107 - Lumbee Fairness Act extends federal recognition to the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina. It makes the tribe and its members eligible for federal services and benefits given to federally recognized tribes, defines a specific service area in North Carolina, directs federal departments to assess tribal needs, allows the Secretary of the Interior to take land into trust for the tribe, and outlines state and federal jurisdiction over tribal lands.

affected_groups.effect: Receive federal recognition, eligibility for federal Indian services and benefits, a defined service area in four North Carolina counties, and potential land-into-trust benefits.
affected_groups.group: The Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina and its members

affected_groups.effect: Retains jurisdiction over criminal offenses and civil actions on land owned by or held in trust for the tribe, subject to potential future transfer agreements.
Must verify tribal rolls, consult with the tribe to determine needs, submit written statements of those needs to Congress, and are authorized to take land into trust.
affected_groups.group: Department of the Interior and Department of Health and Human Services

key_provisions: Extends federal recognition to the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina.
Makes the tribe and its members eligible for all federal services and benefits provided to federally recognized tribes.
Designates members residing in Robeson, Cumberland, Hoke, and Scotland Counties in North Carolina as residing on or near an Indian reservation for service delivery.
Requires the Department of the Interior and the Department of Health and Human Services to consult with the tribe to determine needs and submit written statements to Congress.
Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to take land into trust for the benefit of the tribe, with specific handling for trust acquisitions in Robeson County.
Maintains North Carolina's jurisdiction over criminal offenses and civil actions on tribal or trust lands, unless jurisdiction is transferred to the United States via agreement.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary impacts to provide the federal services and benefits.
Exact timelines for when federal services and benefit delivery will begin following the needs determination.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The S. 107 - Lumbee Fairness Act extends federal recognition to the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina. It makes the tribe and its members eligible for federal services and benefits given to federally recognized tribes, defines a specific service area in North Carolina, directs federal departments to assess tribal needs, allows the Secretary of the Interior to take land into trust for the tribe, and outlines state and federal jurisdiction over tribal lands.
summary_detail.significance: The bill grants formal federal recognition and associated federal benefits to the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina, establishes specific geographic service areas, provides mechanisms for placing land into trust, and sets jurisdictional parameters between the state and federal governments regarding tribal lands.
